title: Brutal Warfare
description: A datapack that adds classes and talisman items to create a more unique pvp experience most similar to a hero shooter like marvel rivals or overwatch.
body:
This datapack is a way to make combat more unique by adding 35 unique classes that players can use. The classes all have different stats and abilities and fit into 4 categories, offense, defense, support, and balance. There are also talismans which are a secondary buff aside from the class. There is also a buff to the classes called a blessing gained through eating an enchanted golden apple and equipping wishing stars. Both of these are obtained through crates which are craftable using a crate core. Crate cores can be found in almost any structure and dropped by some mobs. All information can be found here https://docs.google.com/document/d/12PtexnlSELBhY6KnsMhB_5rYb9GqG7_Paen6olKcHMY/edit?usp=sharing.

(There are built in combat rules found in the document.)
